products.name: Backup Validation & Recoverability Assurance Program — Commercial
products.short_description: Prove your backups actually restore. A program for Microsoft 365 (Exchange/SharePoint/OneDrive/Teams via third-party SaaS backup) and Azure Backup — coverage standards, RPO/RTO targets, a scheduled restore-test cadence, per-workload test restores, evidence capture, and audit-ready reporting. Self-guided, tested.
products.description:
Don't hope your backups restore — prove it, on a schedule, with evidence

"We have backups" is not the same as "we can restore." Coverage gaps, untested jobs, and vague RPO/RTO turn a routine request into a disaster. This solution is a recoverability assurance program: establish a coverage baseline across Microsoft 365 (Exchange/SharePoint/OneDrive/Teams via third-party SaaS backup — because M365 retention is not backup) and Azure Backup, set RPO/RTO targets, run a scheduled cadence of test restores per workload, capture evidence, and produce audit-ready reports — so recoverability is proven, not assumed.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — the assurance model: coverage → RPO/RTO → scheduled restore tests → evidence → reporting.
  • Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (a M365 backup product + admin, Azure Backup / Recovery Services vault, defined RPO/RTO, a safe restore sandbox, evidence store) with how to verify and how to implement it if missing, plus the category Global Requirements.
  • Implementation Guide — coverage baseline, restore-test schedule, per-workload test-restore procedures (Exchange/SPO/OneDrive/Teams + Azure VM/file), evidence capture, and reporting (with full Azure Backup nav paths).
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — backup-coverage discovery, RPO/last-restore validation, recoverability assurance report, unprotected-resource remediation flags, and a restore-test scheduler.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with pass/fail gates (every in-scope workload restores within RTO, evidence captured), plus Best Practices.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

Every in-scope M365 and Azure workload has a recent, passing test restore within its RTO, backed by captured evidence and audit-ready reporting — recoverability proven, not assumed.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • BACKUPVAL-Discovery.ps1 — BACKUPVAL-Discovery - Inventory backup coverage across Azure Recovery Services
    • BACKUPVAL-Remediation.ps1 — BACKUPVAL-Remediation - Flag unprotected Azure resources and (optionally)
    • BACKUPVAL-Report.ps1 — BACKUPVAL-Report - Produce the recoverability assurance report data:
    • BACKUPVAL-Set-RestoreTestSchedule.ps1 — BACKUPVAL-Set-RestoreTestSchedule - Scaffold and track the restore-test
    • BACKUPVAL-Validation.ps1 — BACKUPVAL-Validation - Verify last-backup recency against RPO and last

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all five PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
